crossRefs.note: A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer…
Asahel pursued Abner; and in going he didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Asahel
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
translations.bsb: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)
translations.kjv: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
translations.asv: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
